title: Python Foundations
description: Learn the basic building blocks of Python including variables, strings, integers, and floats.

missions.title: Hello World
missions.description: Every programmer starts here. Forge your very first instruction to print text to the console.
missions.objective: Print exactly "Hello, World!" to the console.
hints: Use the print() function with double quotes around Hello, World!
Example: print("Hello, World!")

missions.title: Variables
missions.description: Variables act as containers to store data values. Let's assign a value and display it.
missions.objective: Create a variable named message, assign "Python Forge" to it, then print it.
hints: Assign "Python Forge" to message using message = "Python Forge"
Then call print(message) on the next line.

missions.title: Integers
missions.description: Learn how Python stores whole numbers using integer variables.
missions.objective: Create a variable named age with the value 18 and print it.
hints: Numbers do not need quotation marks.
Write: age = 18 followed by print(age)

missions.title: Floats
missions.description: Store decimal numbers using floating-point variables.
missions.objective: Create a variable named temperature with the value 36.5 and print it.
hints: Float numbers use a decimal point.
Write: temperature = 36.5 followed by print(temperature)

missions.title: Strings
missions.description: Create text variables using string formatting.
missions.objective: Create a variable named city with the value "Kashmir" and print it.
hints: Strings must be wrapped in single or double quotes.
Write: city = "Kashmir" followed by print(city)

title: Control Flow & Decisions
description: Master program logic using booleans, comparison operators, and if-elif-else conditional blocks.

missions.title: Booleans
missions.description: Booleans represent truth values in Python: True or False.
missions.objective: Create a variable named is_active set to True and print it.
hints: In Python, True and False start with a capital letter.
Write: is_active = True followed by print(is_active)

missions.title: The IF Statement
missions.description: Use if statements to execute code only when a condition is True.
missions.objective: Create a variable score = 85. Write an if statement checking if score > 50, and print "Passed".
hints: Don't forget the colon (:) at the end of the if statement line and indent the print line.

Write:
score = 85
if score > 50:
    print("Passed")

missions.title: Else Fallback
missions.description: Use else blocks to provide a fallback path when the condition is False.
missions.objective: Create age = 15. If age >= 18 print "Adult", else print "Minor".
hints: Use else: on its own line after the if block.

missions.title: Elif Chains
missions.description: Chain multiple conditions together using elif (else if).
missions.objective: Create speed = 70. If speed > 80 print "Fast", elif speed > 50 print "Normal", else print "Slow".
hints: Chain elif speed > 50: between the if and else conditions.

missions.title: Logical AND / OR
missions.description: Combine multiple conditions using the 'and' and 'or' keywords.
missions.objective: Create age = 20 and has_license = True. If age >= 18 and has_license print "Drive", else print "No".
hints: Use the 'and' keyword to join age >= 18 and has_license.

Write:
age = 20
has_license = True
if age >= 18 and has_license:
    print("Drive")
else:
    print("No")
